name: terraform-drift-report
description: GitHub Action: parse Terraform/OpenTofu plan JSON into TSM drift counts + summary and optionally POST to the TSM callback.

scripts.build: ncc build src/index.ts -o dist --minify --no-source-map-register && ncc build src/cleanup.ts -o dist/cleanup-build --minify --no-source-map-register && mv dist/cleanup-build/index.js dist/cleanup.js && rm -rf dist/cleanup-build
